scope: Owner-authorized optimizer-interference diagnostic only. No full fit, trajectory, automatic retry, coefficient tuning or model checkpoint writes.

parent_protocol.scope: Bounded scientific screen only. No full fit, automatic continuation, sweep, seed search or target scoring.
parent_protocol.hypothesis: Retaining native location supervision while making point allocation target-consistent and invariant to uniform density scaling may improve dense learning without sparse/spatial regression.
parent_protocol.candidate_status: Mathematical and frozen-forward diagnosis completed; no demonstrated parameter-update gain or novelty.

required_before_execution: Safe restricted load of hash-pinned authentic resume states; both saved models must equal verified final checkpoints
Authentic AdamW state step 25592 and hyperparameters verified; report historical-momentum limitation
Implement and hash all objectives, normalized-denominator derivative, zero-count behavior and finite/recovery checks
Verify all source inputs/native target multiplicities, replay, and memory estimates before resource admission

raw_arms.normalized_isotropic_control: primary_V11 + 0.5 N ||R_isotropic(D/S-T/N)||1; sigma one native cell, no exemplar geometry
raw_arms.DM_local_adapted: base + existing 0.1 normalized OT + 0.01 count-weighted normalized TV, identical frozen solver/tolerances
raw_arms.DM_objective_adapted: count L1 + existing 0.1 normalized OT + 0.01 count-weighted normalized TV
raw_arms.no_local: base=count L1 + .25 regional L1 + 5 marginal CDF

post_Adam_controls: normalized_blur displacement from primary matched to candidate
normalized_isotropic displacement from primary matched to candidate
DM_local displacement from primary matched to candidate
whole-primary displacement from native matched to candidate

optimizer.precision: CPU FP32 for diagnostic; not CUDA BF16 accuracy

stage_B.evaluation: Each update batch, original rotating 12 disjoint balanced fitting spillover images, all 17 supplemental probes. Per-image and query-weighted summaries; repeated probes are dependent.

required_on: separately reported supplemental dense and extreme probes
gate.numerical_tolerance_per_cell: 1e-4 + 1e-6 * abs(primary post-update mass); GAME tolerance is summed cell tolerance
other: Beat simpler and displacement-matched controls beyond numerical tolerance
Improve normalized blur and instance spatial discrepancies
All finite checks and exact state/input preservation

stage_C.requires: Stage B gate passes; separately freeze exact split/order/initialization and all scripts before execution
stage_C.limits: No favorable checkpoint selection or automatic full-training transition; independent fitting spillover and all extreme probes retained.

before_any_full_run: Primary PML implementation and coefficient audit; matched comparator readiness
CUDA FP32/BF16 and model/optimizer/RNG recovery guards
Freeze full training budget/recipe before native validation
interpretation_limits: Seen fitting data and one seed are not independent validation
Radial invariance is not count preservation after Adam
No external, sack or reserved accuracy or novelty claim

active_design.query_order: Original eight update images, remaining forty original fitting images in original order, all seventeen supplemental images.
active_design.first_moment_intervention: Zero exp_avg only; exp_avg_sq, saved step 25592 and all other optimizer fields remain authentic before each disposable step.
active_design.clipping: Original global norm1 versus no clipping; no learning-rate or loss-weight changes.
controls: zero current gradient with preserved moments and clip1, active parameter mask retained
each raw proposal plus post-Adam norm match to native-to-original-primary displacement
active_design.synthetic_optimizer_checks: Separate tiny tensors, no checkpoint states, excluded from scientific checkpoint-call count.
active_design.directional_checks: Primary/auxiliary/candidate negative gradients before/after clip, raw and matched Adam displacements, candidate-primary increments, named-parameter-group dot products.
active_design.finite_differences: Central differences at fixed unit-direction radii .01 and .005 for original primary and joint-intervention matched candidate. Report both versus analytic derivatives, no radius search; smooth output metrics can still cross model kinks. These diagnose linearization, not accuracy.
active_design.synthetic_derivative_gate: Copied loss finite-difference and radial-invariance checks must pass; real-model central differences must remain finite and all errors are reported.

decision_rules.prespecified_contrast: candidate_anchored__zero_unclipped__matched; joint removal of both suspected factors is fixed before any run. Other factorial conditions cannot replace it posthoc.
decision_rules.dense: In each of six checkpoint/batch contexts, every nonempty role/dense cell plus supplemental/extreme must improve MAE by at least 1% and beyond count tolerance versus BOTH its matched primary and original primary; also beat matched null beyond tolerance.
decision_rules.interaction: All candidate-minus-primary contrasts use norm-matched proposals. Joint-intervention dense MAE difference must be lower beyond count tolerance than keep+clip matched candidate-minus-primary; report all 2x2 main effects and mixed interaction, no posthoc winner.
decision_rules.protection: In every context and nonempty role/stratum(all,sparse,medium,dense,extreme), GAME1/2/3 must not worsen beyond tolerance against both primary comparators. Sparse/medium count MAE must also be protected. Do not pool away any failed context.
decision_rules.spatial: Both normalized blur/instance L1 discrepancies must improve beyond 1e-6 on all/dense/extreme cells versus both primary comparators; other strata may not worsen beyond 1e-6.
decision_rules.tolerance: Per comparator predicted mass cell 1e-4+1e-6*abs(mass), sum cells for GAME then mean observations; count is one cell.
decision_rules.raw_and_other_factorial_conditions: Report every signed effect and protection failure. Descriptive only, cannot rescue prespecified contrast.
decision_rules.consequence: Even a pass only supports further bounded mechanism investigation. No automatic trajectory or full training.

interpretation_limits: Seen fitting images, dependent repeated evaluations, late optimizer and one seed.
First-moment reset retains second moments and optimizer age; not fresh Adam.
Not a new loss, production optimizer recommendation, validation improvement, independent generalization or novelty.
inherited_protocol_note: Parent protocol is retained as source/selection provenance only. Old Stage B/C budgets and gates are superseded for this diagnostic by active_design/decision_rules above.
